summary.text: The food path researches how to feed Gu worms, beasts, variant humans, and humans, and later shows methods that add dao marks through eating.

claims.text: The novel introduces food path as a secretive cultivation path whose early public face is feeding, then expands it into inheritances, Immortal Gu, killer moves, and dao-mark work.

Lang Ya land spirit states that Giant Sun Immortal Venerable used food path methods, and that food path is solely for research on how to feed Gu worms, variant humans, wild beasts, and even humans. The land spirit knows nothing further because Long Hair Ancestor swore with Giant Sun not to reveal those food path methods.
Fang Yuan sees that Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage holds the mysteries of food path, since the Gu worms that form this Immortal Gu House are full and in excellent condition.
Fang Yuan judges that only a non-standard path like Shadow Sect’s food path true inheritances could damage his defensive divination tortoise transformation.

The teas discussed in the pavilion at the moon festival Qiao Si Liu hosts, willow spiral tea, bewitching tea, drunken flowers, nine recollecting fragrances, and yin-yang tea, are all incomplete Gu recipes; when such a recipe is completed, a Gu Immortal who brews the tea can refine food path Gu worms. Food path has never flourished, and although it is highly significant and widely desired, historical reasons have left very few food path inheritances in the world.

Dragonfish are not a natural life form. They were created by a food path Gu Immortal, and that creator was the beastman who created food path itself. Fang Yuan obtains that beastman’s inheritance from Shadow Sect and uses its breeding methods plus a food path immortal Gu formation to raise higher-quality dragonfish.

Outside Gu Immortals infer that he holds a food path true inheritance and try to buy it. You Chan had once obtained a food path inheritance of her own, not as authentic as his, and it is because she held that inheritance that she chose the dragonfish business as her main source of income. She had already been trying to modify her dragonfish’s quality without success, and she puts that lack of progress down to her own food path attainment being too low.

Food path is very rarely passed down. Because there are too few food path Gu Immortals, there are also very few food path Immortal Gu. Spectral Soul uses food path killer moves such as bitter taste, swallow loss, and eat heart, but after devouring Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven his gains in food path Immortal Gu are still minuscule, so he cannot exert the full strength of his food path. Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable created counters specially against Spectral Soul’s food path moves.

Fang Yuan later states that he had long thought food path mainly excelled at feeding Gu and reducing burden, but that this is only one advantage. The true power of food path is to help a Gu cultivator gain extra dao marks and raise foundation: it sustains livelihood while specific methods make the target stronger than before. Most food path killer moves are used on the user themselves. Reckless Savage Demon Venerable and Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable both have deep food path understanding, and Fang Yuan combines Shadow Sect’s original food path inheritance with Paradise Earth’s food path killer moves and totem recipes from Myriad Beast Fusion Color Heaven. Because food path is not popularized, ordinary Gu Immortals cannot effectively defend against it, though he still ranks it a minor method against venerable-level foes.
